changes.observation: Title, English and descriptor became smaller with more cleared land; practical schedule and right-bank text were retained at useful sizes.
Fine stippling diminished, with larger shrubs and more discrete leaf clusters.
Chair shadows became more explicit; speaker and four attentive listeners remain supported.

maintained_advantages: All ten literal entries readable once
Continuous bridge/river and two content-grounded gatherings
residuals: Remaining botanical detail and soft ground/water tone limit the planned flat architectural system.
The viewpoint remains a high oblique scenic scene rather than a strong overhead site drawing.
